Its pair, Guyot's Chevaux et chien (x +16.5 in the fountain's frame), has no usable photo.

name: Jardins du Trocadéro: La Jeunesse (Pierre Poisson)
note: The carved block at the river end of the Fontaine de Varsovie, east side, the pair of Drivier's La Joie de vivre (img2glb batch, west); at the point assetkit's subject gives (the mirror of La Joie de vivre across the axis). Its carved face toward the river (bearing 110 turns the model's 24° yaw onto 134); 2.4 m to match its pair, on the ground: a pedestal would turn with the bearing, 24° off the block. assetkit img2glb guided from Commons 'Sculpture de Pierre-Marie Poisson, Paris.jpg' (one face only, so a second copy, trocadero-jeunesse-poisson-dos, stands back to back with it, each 0.55 m off the block's middle). The batch model of it, la-jeunesse-poisson, was rejected in review.

name: Jardins du Trocadéro: La Jeunesse (Pierre Poisson), garden face
note: The garden face of the block: the same model as trocadero-jeunesse-poisson turned round, back to back with it (the real block is carved on both long faces; the photo shows one).

name: Palais de Chaillot: Hercule et le taureau de Crète (Pommier)
